name: Kayano Yuuna
source:
She goes to the 'Murota Academy' cooking school.
She admires the boy that made a pasta she ate as a child so she aims to become a chef herself.
She gets an internship at a restaurant called Arcobaleno where the pasta reminds her of the delicious pasta that she ate 10 years ago.
